==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*visnǫti}}. {{surf|ru|висе́ть|-нуть}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|ви́снуть}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|ви́снуть|impf}}

# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[droop]], to [[hang]] down, to [[dangle]]
#: {{syn|ru|висе́ть}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial|pejorative}} to [[hang on]] (to), to [[cling]] (to)
#: {{uxi|ru|'''ви́снуть''' [[у]] [[кто-либо|кого́-либо]] [[на]] [[шея|ше́е]]|to hang on someone's neck}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial|computing}} to [[freeze up]]
#: {{pf|ru|зави́снуть}}
